changes: Additive SQLite 120/PostgreSQL 022 add nullable cancelled_at without rebuilding operation rows or changing their existing phase CHECK. Read models expose cancelled as a terminal phase; no message/ciphertext snapshot is stored.

Repository CancelSend atomically fences prepared sends. If the original request has not arrived yet, it inserts a permanent account/group/request-scoped cancellation tombstone so a delayed PrepareSend cannot create a message. It races on the same operation row as CreateMessage; if commit wins, cancellation returns the real committed/completed state and never deletes a message or attachment.

Current-member/sender-authorized, rate-limited POST .../send-operations/{requestId}/cancel returns the actual outcome with no-store. Repeated cancellation is idempotent. Original matching-hash cancelled POSTs return 410 SEND_CANCELLED; a missing-row tombstone whose hash does not match rejects a late prepare with 409. Route golden and OpenAPI were updated.

Client provides a confirmation-gated cancel-if-not-sent button. Pending state is cleared only after validated cancelled confirmation; timeouts, malformed or already-committed outcomes retain the original operation. Same-account/group cancellation is permitted after a local device change because it sends no old ciphertext and never resumes an old-device write.

Cancellation preserves current drafts. Original files removed from a newer draft remain in an explicitly labelled review-only recovery entry, unless an existing failed-upload source already retains them. No automatic new send or replacement of newer text occurs. Delayed confirmation checks the captured request ID so it cannot cancel a replacement operation.
